Part C - Summary or timeline setting out visits/inspections carried out by FSD at Wang Fuk Court since the commencement of the renovation in July 2024

7. Timeline of Visits, Inspections and Enforcement by FSD

7.1 In general, visits/inspections to a domestic estate like Wang Fuk Court by various units of the FSD are generally initiated from 3 aspects, namely fire hazard complaints, FSI related visits/inspections and proactive visits by local fire stations. [FSD/G(I)/17]

Inspection arising from Fire Hazard Complaints

7.1.1 All fire hazard complaints received by the FSD are governed by the departmental general procedure. When the FSD receives complaints regarding suspected fire hazards such as obstruction to means of escapes (“MoE”) or emergency vehicular access (“EVA”), and locked exits, etc., the case would be followed up by the responsible unit according to its nature and priority. High priority cases are restricted to hazards posing an “imminent danger” to life, such as locked escape routes. For these cases, the department pledges to commence an investigation within 24 hours, often deploying local fire station crews or designated task force to take immediate abatement action. Other than the high priority cases, normal priority investigations encompass the majority of regulatory breaches, such as licensing irregularities that do not pose an immediate catastrophic threat. These cases trigger an inspection by the specified fire protection units within 10 working days. [FSD/G(I)/5]
